notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation and Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak each turn.
description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Pinnacle Monk by paying its mana cost.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Pinnacle Monk from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
